capability.method: Chronological, label-maturity-purged logit/HGB with separate sigmoid calibration and episode metrics
capability.state: research-estimator; explicit panel and target required
capability.upstream: scikit-learn; experiment design informed by BoE WP848

result.target_definition: JST systemic banking crisis onset during the next three calendar years; yearly end-date convention; current onset and four subsequent information-years excluded

parameters.calibrator: sigmoid fit only in calibration block
sigmoid fit only in calibration block

alarm_rule.decision_rationale: Predeclared research comparison at a 10% negative-period alarm budget; not a China or household action threshold

result.probability_admission: Scores are research outputs. China transfer and probability use require an independent model-card decision; fitting/calibration alone does not grant that use.
